content.short: Vivid Money is a European mobile finance app combining accounts, cards, investing and cashback rewards.
content.description: Vivid Money is a European mobile finance app, headquartered in Germany, that combines everyday banking with investing and rewards in one account. Users get a current account with IBAN, physical and virtual cards, sub-accounts called Pockets for organizing and sharing money, cashback rewards, and the ability to invest in stocks, ETFs and other assets, with crypto exposure in some markets, plus business accounts. Vivid positions itself as a financial super app for people who want to spend, save and invest without juggling separate providers, targeting retail customers across several European countries. By blending banking, multi-currency features, investing and cashback into one polished app, it competes with other European challengers like Revolut and N26.
